inputs.text: One of the three inputs into the gate whose output is J: that output is 10V only while all of them are high.
One of the three inputs into the gate whose output is K: that output is 10V only while all of them are high.
One of the three inputs into the gate whose output is L: that output is 10V only while all of them are high.

outputs.text: 10V while A, B and C are all high, 0V as soon as any of them goes low.
10V while D, E and F are all high, 0V as soon as any of them goes low.
10V while G, H and I are all high, 0V as soon as any of them goes low.

notes: A logic input counts as high once it rises above 2V and does not count as low again until it falls below 0.1V; a logic output is 10V for high and 0V for low.
